repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Folded into this card · 2026-11-17T00:33Z · carrier asked by contract review 6933857477 ③ on PR #34355

A second cell of the same class (one operation, one answer), measured by the dev on PR #34355 (report 6933618339 on #33210, out-of-scope finding):

Base A and dependent D (D declares A) each store an `en-US` row of `email_template` `N`; D also stores `fr-FR`. `GET /api/v1/meta/email_template/N?member=en-US` naming no package, and its `/layers` and execution read:

| How A holds `N` | Answer |
|:---|:---|
| shipped | 200, A's row |
| row-held | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming A and D, before and after a restart |

PR #34355 does not move it (the same 409 was measured without the change, before a restart). It is now pinned as observed in the `S2` test of `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`. Likely cause, by code read only: the row-held arm handles only a named member that is not the canonical one, so the canonical shared member falls through to `storedRowHoldersRefusal`, although the registry judges D's row an addition.

Acceptance for this cell: the shared canonical member answers the same way whether the base ships the name or holds it as a row, stated against ADR-0146 and ADR-0150 red line 2 (a ruling first if needed), with pins for both holdings.
